summary: FTAI Infrastructure's indirect subsidiary Drub LLC agreed on September 27, 2026 to acquire all outstanding membership interests of DRUbit LLC from DRUbit Holdings for a purchase price based on a $255 million enterprise value, subject to customary cash, indebtedness, net working capital and transaction expense adjustments. The deal includes standard representations, interim operating covenants and HSR antitrust clearance. Buyer secured a conditional buyer-side representations and warranty insurance policy. Closing conditions include no injunctive law or order, HSR expiration or termination, and accurate representations and covenant compliance. Key watch items are financing completion, regulatory clearance timing and purchase-price adjustment mechanics.
